blocks.text: Evaluation is a planned check of the result. Include the task rules and the mistakes that would matter to the user.

blocks.code:
Task: explain rain to a young reader
Check 1: uses short familiar sentences
Check 2: explains clouds and water drops accurately
Check 3: avoids made-up facts
Check 4: answers the actual question
blocks.title: Evaluate with a small checklist

blocks.text: The checks separate writing quality from factual accuracy. A friendly tone does not replace a correct explanation.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a check for an unexplained difficult word.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not score only the examples you liked; include difficult cases too.
